values.note: Nightly sites book on the Campspot marketplace; monthly sites by request to the office (first come, first served, 50% non-refundable deposit). Check-in 2 p.m., no arrivals after 9 p.m. without approval. Cancel 7+ days ahead for a refund less one night; holiday weekends non-refundable.

note: Family-owned campground on 30+ acres in the countryside of Snow Camp, ~12 mi from Burlington; level gravel-pad sites with Spectrum cable TV, a fenced dog park and a playground. Generators and tents not allowed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $50-55 (Campspot live 'Starting at' prices; the operator's undated page says the same), 30/50-amp full hookups, Wi-Fi; added 57 sites with pull-throughs, showers/dump, no laundry on site, open year-round, Campspot booking. Note cleaned of hookup/Wi-Fi text. Not stated: max rig length.
flags: Price gate: base $50 a night on Campspot (back-in full hookups; pull-through $55), at the US$50 line but not over it; no gateway within 40 km (Raleigh 78 km); the family has not stayed here.
